raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- Quark W4A4 MXFP4 dense GEMMs on gfx95 intermittently return NaN when AITER's `gemm_afp4wfp4` picks a config whose `BLOCK_SIZE_K` does not divide K (masked K-tail).
- Cause: a Triton AMD backend bug leaves stale LDS data in masked scale-load lanes instead of `other=127`; a stale `0xFF` is a NaN E8M0 scale. Upstream fix: [triton-lang/triton#11256](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/pull/11256). Triton 3.7.0 and 3.8.0+git4cff872c in current ROCm images still lack it.
- Impact: on an earlier Kimi-K3 checkpoint with MXFP4 shared experts, this produced 71 gibberish GSM8K answers (91.96% vs 97.35%).

## Modifications

- `_aiter_gemm_afp4wfp4` (Quark W4A4 MXFP4 dense linear, gfx95) now passes an explicit config to `gemm_afp4wfp4`:
  - Reads the config `gemm_afp4wfp4` itself would pick (`aiter.ops.triton.gemm_afp4wfp4._get_config`, packed K), cached per `(M, N, K)`.
  - Narrows `BLOCK_SIZE_K` to the largest power of two >= 128 that divides K, so the kernel runs with `EVEN_K`.
  - Keeps every other config field, so tuned tile sizes stay.
- Workaround comment anchored to triton-lang/triton#11256 with its retirement condition.

| Case | Config passed to `gemm_afp4wfp4` |
|---|---|
| Not gfx95, or AITER without `_get_config` | none (AITER's own selection, as before) |
| Config lookup raises `KeyError` / `AssertionError` (no config file / M bucket) | none |
| Split-K config (`NUM_KSPLIT > 1`) | none; left to AITER's `get_splitk` (the NaN did not reproduce on the M <= 8 split-K defaults) |
| `BLOCK_SIZE_K` already divides K | AITER's config |
| `BLOCK_SIZE_K` does not divide K | AITER's config with a narrowed `BLOCK_SIZE_K` |
| No power of two >= 128 divides K (e.g. K=2880) | none, and a one-time warning per K |

- Tests:
  - CPU (`test_quark_mxfp4_asm.py`): block narrowing for Kimi-K3 K=768 / 4224, even and un-narrowable K, config lookup fallbacks, split-K passthrough.
  - MI35x (`test_quark_afp4wfp4_k_tail.py`): fills LDS with `0xFF` before each GEMM and checks against a dequantized reference at N=7168, K=1536, M=16/32; asserts AITER still picks an uneven block for that shape.

## Accuracy Tests

Kernel regression: LDS filled with `0xFF` before each GEMM to reproduce the failure deterministically.

| N / K | AITER config | Failing M before | Failing M with PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7168 / 768 | untuned, old AITER `2bb549102` | 80, 96, 112, 128 | none |
| 7168 / 768 | tuned, pinned AITER | none | none |
| 7168 / 1536 | untuned, pinned AITER | 16, 32 | none |

GSM8K: 1,319 questions, sgl-eval 0.1.3, K3 preset, TP8, radix cache on, one run per config.

| Setup | Before | PR | Delta | Gibberish answers |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Old AITER `2bb549102`, MXFP4 shared experts | 91.96% | 97.35% | +5.39 pp | 71 -> 0 |
| Pinned AITER `285579b6`, current BF16 shared experts | 96.97% | 97.19% | +0.22 pp | not reported |

- The current checkpoint avoids the affected shapes, so its row is a regression check.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

End to end: pinned image, current checkpoint, TP8, cookbook MI355X non-spec recipe, random 8,192 input / 1,024 output tokens, one run per config. Delta = `PR / main - 1`.

| Concurrency | Main TPOT (ms) | PR TPOT (ms) | Delta |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | 20.46 | 20.44 | -0.10% |
| 16 | 28.07 | 28.08 | +0.04% |
| 64 | 46.22 | 46.25 | +0.06% |

- TPOT changes are within 0.1% in this single-run comparison.

Kernel cost: one MI355X, pinned image, cold L2 and Infinity Cache, median of 200 samples.

| Kernel case | Before (us) | PR (us) | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| K=1536 | 6.7 | 6.4 | -4.5% |
| K3 TP8 layer-0 `down_proj`, K=4224 | not reported | not reported | +5 to 12 us |

- The K=4224 overhead occurs once per forward.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 _ASM_FP4_UNSAFE_MAX_N = 128
 
+# gemm_afp4wfp4 raises a Triton BLOCK_SIZE_K below 128 back to 128.
+_AFP4WFP4_MIN_BLOCK_K = 128
+
+
+def _afp4wfp4_even_k_block(block_k: int, k: int) -> Optional[int]:
+    """BLOCK_SIZE_K that divides ``k`` FP4 elements, or None when none at or above the minimum does."""
+    # gemm_afp4wfp4 itself shrinks a block wider than K to K's next power of two.
+    block_k = min(max(block_k, _AFP4WFP4_MIN_BLOCK_K), 1 << (k - 1).bit_length())
+    while block_k > _AFP4WFP4_MIN_BLOCK_K and k % block_k:
+        block_k //= 2
+    return block_k if k % block_k == 0 else None
+
+
+_aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config = None
+if _is_hip:
+    try:
+        # The config getter gemm_afp4wfp4 itself calls when given no config.
+        from aiter.ops.triton.gemm_afp4wfp4 import (
+            _get_config as _aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config,
+        )
+    except ImportError:
+        pass
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _warn_no_even_k_block(k: int) -> None:
+    logger.warning(
+        "MXFP4 gemm_afp4wfp4: K=%d has no power-of-two BLOCK_SIZE_K >= %d dividing it; "
+        "it keeps the masked K-tail path of triton-lang/triton#11256.",
+        k,
+        _AFP4WFP4_MIN_BLOCK_K,
+    )
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
+def _afp4wfp4_even_k_config(m: int, n: int, k_packed: int) -> Optional[dict]:
+    # None keeps AITER's own config selection.
+    if not is_gfx95_supported() or _aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        config, _ = _aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config(m, n, k_packed)
+    except (KeyError, AssertionError):
+        # No config file or M bucket for this shape.
+        return None
+    if config["NUM_KSPLIT"] != 1:
+        # Split-K configs are left to AITER's get_splitk;
+        # the stale-LDS NaN did not reproduce on the M <= 8 split-K defaults on MI355X.
+        return None
+    k = 2 * k_packed
+    even_block_k = _afp4wfp4_even_k_block(block_k=config["BLOCK_SIZE_K"], k=k)
+    if even_block_k is None:
+        _warn_no_even_k_block(k)
+        return None
+    return {**config, "BLOCK_SIZE_K": even_block_k}
+

+"""Quark W4A4 MXFP4 dense GEMM on gfx950 when K is not a whole number of AITER's BLOCK_SIZE_K:
+outputs must match a dequantized reference whatever the previous kernel left in LDS."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=30, stage="stage-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# Untuned at ROCm/aiter@285579b62, so DEFAULT.json picks BLOCK_SIZE_K=1024 for 8 < M <= 32;
+# an M that is a multiple of 16 takes the stale-LDS path.
+N, K = 7168, 1536
+MS = (16, 32)
+# Power of two at or above the ~105 KB of LDS this GEMM config uses.
+_LDS_BYTES = 128 * 1024
+
+
+def _make_lds_fill():
+    from triton.experimental import gluon
+    from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+
+    @gluon.jit
+    def _lds_fill_kernel(out_ptr, value, NUM_WORDS: gl.constexpr):
+        layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([NUM_WORDS // 256], [64], [4], [0])
+        smem_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, [0])
+        smem = gl.allocate_shared_memory(gl.int32, [NUM_WORDS], smem_layout)
+        smem.store(gl.full([NUM_WORDS], value, gl.int32, layout))
+        # Read back so the store is not dead.
+        gl.store(out_ptr + gl.program_id(0), gl.sum(smem.load(layout), axis=0))
+
+    def lds_fill(byte: int) -> None:
+        """Leave ``byte`` in every CU's LDS, as a previous kernel would."""
+        num_programs = 4096
+        out = torch.empty(num_programs, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        value = int.from_bytes(bytes([byte] * 4), "little", signed=True)
+        _lds_fill_kernel[(num_programs,)](out, value, _LDS_BYTES // 4, num_warps=4)
+
+    return lds_fill
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_hip() and is_gfx95_supported(), "gfx950 MXFP4 GEMM")
+class TestQuarkAfp4wfp4KTail(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        from aiter.ops.triton.quant import dynamic_mxfp4_quant
+        from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_to_f32, mxfp4_to_f32
+
+        def dequant(q, scale):
+            values = mxfp4_to_f32(q)
+            scale = e8m0_to_f32(scale).repeat_interleave(32, dim=-1)
+            return values * scale[:, : values.shape[-1]]
+
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        w_q, w_s = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(
+            (torch.randn(N, K, device="cuda") * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        )
+        cls.w_q = w_q
+        # Checkpoint weight scales are row-major; activation scales keep the quant layout.
+        cls.w_s = w_s.contiguous()
+        w_ref = dequant(w_q, w_s)
+        cls.inputs = {}
+        for m in MS:
+            x_q, x_s = dynamic_mxfp4_quant(
+                (torch.randn(m, K, device="cuda") * 0.05).to(torch.bfloat16)
+            )
+            cls.inputs[m] = (x_q, x_s, dequant(x_q, x_s) @ w_ref.t())
+        cls.lds_fill = staticmethod(_make_lds_fill())
+
+    def _assert_matches_reference(self):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.quark.schemes.quark_w4a4_mxfp4 import (
+            _aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config,
+            gemm_afp4wfp4,
+        )
+
+        for m, (x_q, x_s, ref) in self.inputs.items():
+            with self.subTest(m=m):
+                aiter_config, _ = _aiter_afp4wfp4_get_config(m, N, K // 2)
+                # Guard the premise: once AITER tunes this shape to an even block, pick another.
+                self.assertNotEqual(K % aiter_config["BLOCK_SIZE_K"], 0)
+                y = torch.zeros((m, N), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+                # 0xFF is a NaN E8M0 scale; a K-tail that reads stale LDS turns it into NaN.
+                self.lds_fill(0xFF)
+                gemm_afp4wfp4(x_q, self.w_q, x_s, self.w_s, torch.bfloat16, y)
+                err = (y.float() - ref).abs().nan_to_num(float("inf"))
+                self.assertLessEqual(err.max().item(), 0.02 * ref.abs().max().item())
+
+    def test_matches_dequantized_reference(self):
+        self._assert_matches_reference()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
